user.title: Bambu Lab account
user.description: Sign in with your Bambu Lab account to access your cloud filament library. The password is only sent to Bambu Lab and is not stored.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Bambu Lab sent a verification code to {email}. Enter it here. If it did not arrive, leave the field empty and enable "Request new code".

tfa.title: Two-factor authentication
tfa.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose what the integration should do beyond mirroring your library. Everything can be changed later via the integration's Configure button.

data_description.auto_dedup_manual: When the AMS registers a new official spool, one matching full, manually created spool is deleted from the cloud library - pre-entered stock no longer turns into duplicates.
data_description.auto_register_ams: When an official RFID spool sits in an AMS slot but is missing from the cloud library, it is added automatically - no need to open the Bambu app or Studio first. Uses the AMS slot sensors of the Bambu Lab printer integration.
data_description.auto_register_ams_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.sync_ams_remaining: Pushes the AMS remaining-weight estimate of official RFID spools to the library whenever it changes - like Studio does, but without Studio running. A spool reading 0 % is booked as empty immediately. Uses the Bambu Lab printer integration.
data_description.sync_ams_remaining_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.empty_on_removal_pct: Optional extra rule: any spool taken out of the AMS whose last reading was at or below this percentage is set to 0 g, regardless of printing. Leave at 0 unless you want that.
data_description.empty_on_removal_pct_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.deduct_print_usage: Bambu never books consumption for third-party spools. With this on, every print job finished after enabling is booked once against the manual spool the library shows in that AMS slot, using the per-slot grams the cloud records for the job. RFID spools are never touched; jobs already booked elsewhere are skipped. Cancelled jobs are booked proportionally when the printer integration saw the progress.
data_description.empty_on_runout: The safe runout rule: a spool that was the active tray of a running or paused print (an AMS backup switch is remembered too) and is then taken out of the AMS before that print ends is set to 0 g. Spools removed after a finished print, or mid-print with more than 20 % left (filament change), are never touched.
data_description.empty_on_runout_unavailable: Requires the Bambu Lab printer integration (ha-bambulab), which is not installed or not loaded: {bambulab_url}
data_description.tray_command: "Own command" uses the local command of the Bambu Lab printer integration (bambu_lab.set_filament). "Call an action" calls the action below first, with the data befehl = ams/set_tray and daten = (ams_id, slot, filament_id, color, type); its response status 200 = slot set, 409 = RFID slot (only bind), 404 or no answer = fall back to the own command.
data_description.tray_service: e.g. rest_command.my_printer_agent. Only used with "Call an action".
data_description.notify_service: Called with title and message when a sort (material + colour) is down to its last spool, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone or script.my_push. Empty = only a persistent notification.
data_description.tag_devices: Empty = every phone with the Companion app.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed - check email and password.
error.code_incorrect: The code was not accepted - try again.
error.code_resent: A new code was sent - check your inbox and enter it above.
error.cloudflare: Blocked by Cloudflare bot protection - try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Bambu cloud.

abort.wrong_account: Re-authentication must use the same Bambu account this entry was set up with.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the filament library from the Bambu cloud immediately.

set_remaining.name: Set remaining weight
set_remaining.description: Set the remaining filament weight of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: New remaining filament weight in grams (without the spool itself).

set_note.name: Set note
set_note.description: Set the note of a spool in the cloud library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

set_filament_id.name: Set slicer profile (filament ID)
set_filament_id.description: Link a spool to a Bambu filament profile so Bambu Studio can assign it with matching print settings (e.g. GFA00 for Bambu PLA Basic, GFL99 for Generic PLA). An empty string unlinks the profile again.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

filament_id.name: Filament ID
filament_id.description: Bambu filament profile id from the catalog (get_catalog action), or empty to unlink.

create_spool.name: Create spool
create_spool.description: Add a new spool to the Bambu cloud filament library (appears in Studio and the Bambu app too).

material.name: Material
material.description: Material type, e.g. PLA or PETG.

name.name: Filament name
name.description: Product line name, e.g. PLA Matte.

remaining_g.name: Remaining weight
remaining_g.description: Current remaining grams (defaults to the spool size).

filament_id.name: Filament ID
filament_id.description: Optional Bambu filament id (e.g. GFA01); resolved automatically for official filaments.

display_name.name: Custom name
display_name.description: Optional user-facing spool name shown in Studio, the Bambu app and Home Assistant.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note; shown as the spool's remark in Bambu Studio (written right after creation - the create endpoint itself has no note field).

count.name: Count
count.description: How many identical spools to create (1-50), e.g. for sealed stock. All fields apply to every spool.

empty_spool.name: Empty spool
empty_spool.description: Id of the empty spool (tare) this spool sits on; remembered for later weighing.

gross_g.name: Gross weight
gross_g.description: Scale reading of spool + filament; remaining = this minus the empty spool. Needs empty_spool.

color_name.name: Colour name
color_name.description: Own colour name, used for display and the low-stock sorts.

update_spool.name: Update spool
update_spool.description: Change fields of an existing spool in the Bambu cloud library. Only the provided fields are written; empty strings clear the custom name, note or slicer profile.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool (see the spool sensor's spool_id attribute).

material.name: Material
material.description: Material type, e.g. PLA or PETG.

name.name: Filament name
name.description: Product line name, e.g. PLA Matte.

get_catalog.name: Get filament catalog
get_catalog.description: Returns the vendor/product combinations the Bambu cloud accepts when creating spools, plus the account's own slicer presets (usable as filament_id).

delete_spool.name: Delete spool
delete_spool.description: Delete a spool from the Bambu cloud filament library.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the spool to delete.

assign_spool.name: Assign spool to AMS slot
assign_spool.description: Put a library spool into an AMS slot: sets the filament on the printer tray first, then binds the spool to the slot in the Bambu cloud. Refused while the printer is busy.

spool_id.name: Spool ID
spool_id.description: The cloud id of the library spool.

tray.name: AMS tray
tray.description: The Bambu Lab AMS tray sensor of the target slot.

set_printer.name: Set printer tray
set_printer.description: Also write the filament to the printer tray (recommended; Studio drops bindings that do not match the tray).

unassign_slot.name: Unassign AMS slot
unassign_slot.description: Remove the library spool binding of an AMS slot in the Bambu cloud (the printer tray is not changed).

tray.name: AMS tray
tray.description: The Bambu Lab AMS tray sensor of the slot.

weigh_spool.name: Weigh spool
weigh_spool.description: Set the remaining filament from a scale reading, with or without the empty spool.

weight_g.name: Scale reading
weight_g.description: What the scale shows in grams.

with_spool.name: With spool
with_spool.description: On: reading includes the empty spool (its tare is subtracted). Off: filament only.

empty_spool.name: Empty spool
empty_spool.description: Empty spool id; default is the one the spool remembered or its brand's.

set_empty_spool.name: Set empty spool
set_empty_spool.description: Create an empty spool (name + weight) or update an existing one.

empty_spool.name: Empty spool
empty_spool.description: Id to update; leave out to create a new one.

weight_g.name: Weight
weight_g.description: Tare weight of the empty spool in grams.

vendor.name: Brand
vendor.description: Brand this empty spool belongs to (preselection).

delete_empty_spool.name: Delete empty spool
delete_empty_spool.description: Remove an empty spool from the list.

archive_spool.name: Archive spool
archive_spool.description: Archive an empty spool (keeps it with its history) or bring it back.

get_history.name: Get spool history
get_history.description: Bookings of a spool (prints, weighing, create, archive), newest first.

set_color_name.name: Set colour name
set_color_name.description: Own colour name of a spool (display and low-stock sorts).

load_spool.name: Load spool into slot
load_spool.description: Puts a library spool into an AMS slot: checks that the printer is idle, releases the spool from another slot, sets the printer slot (own command or the configured action) and binds the spool in the cloud.

tray.name: Slot
tray.description: AMS slot sensor of the Bambu Lab integration.

weight_g.name: Scale reading
weight_g.description: Optional: weight on the scale right after loading; booked as remaining filament.

with_spool.name: With spool
with_spool.description: The scale reading includes the empty spool (default).

empty_spool.name: Empty spool
empty_spool.description: Empty spool id for the tare; default: the one this spool remembered.

unload_slot.name: Empty slot
unload_slot.description: Clears the spool binding of an AMS slot (only while the printer is idle).

tray.name: Slot
tray.description: AMS slot sensor of the Bambu Lab integration.
